subject: Atlas Health — renewal onboarding roadmap & exec demo request
messages:
From: Emma Sanders <emma.sanders@atlashealth.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: 2025-08-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal planning & exec demo request

Hi Evelyn,

Hope you’re well — our contract with Redwood is up for renewal in late September and the leadership team asked me to start planning. A couple items we want to cover:

- We’re evaluating a move from a 12-month to a 24-month term for predictability.
- We need to add two dedicated GPU nodes for peak processing (estimate: +40% throughput).
- Security will want the latest SOC2 evidence and a short compliance checklist.

Can we schedule a 30–45 minute kickoff/QBR to align on timeline, stakeholders, and a short executive demo of the latest batching/throughput improvements? Prefer the week of Aug 11; we have Exec availability on Aug 12 (10–11am PT) or Aug 13 (1–2pm PT).

Attaching a short note with our renewal ask. Happy to loop in our procurement and engineering leads (cc’ing Carlos).

Thanks,
Emma Sanders
Director, Cloud Ops
Atlas Health
emma.sanders@atlashealth.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: atlas-renewal-ask.txt (text summary)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Emma Sanders <emma.sanders@atlashealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2025-08-04T09:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning & exec demo request

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear summary and the proposed windows. Happy to take this forward.

Quick plan:
1) Kickoff/QBR + exec demo (45m) to cover timeline, capacity sizing, and demo of the continuous batching gains.
2) Technical deep-dive with Carlos/eng to validate the +40% capacity uplift and configuration.
3) Procurement/Legal touchpoint to discuss 24m term pricing and any draft amendments.

Proposed slots (we’ll hold tentatively):
- Tue Aug 12, 10:30–11:15 PT — Exec + Solutions demo (Emily/Prod Eng + Rishi)
- Wed Aug 13, 1:00–1:45 PT — Technical deep-dive (Carlos + Lauren + Eng)

I’m attaching a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template and a short security worksheet for your SOC2 asks — please review and tell us which stakeholders should be responsible for each line item.

Next steps for us: I’ll create the MAP in HubSpot and add the proposed calendar invites; Rishi will follow up on pricing options for a 24-month term and a dedicated GPU uplift.

If those slots work, we’ll lock them and send a short pre-read.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Attachment: renewal-MAP.xlsx (xlsx)
Attachment: security-worksheet.pdf (pdf)

From: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@atlashealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>; Emma Sanders <emma.sanders@atlashealth.com>
Date: 2025-08-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning & exec demo request

On Mon, Aug 4, 2025 at 9:48 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick plan:
> 1) Kickoff/QBR + exec demo (45m) to cover timeline, capacity sizing, and demo of the continuous batching gains.
>
Thanks — that looks good. I’ll be the technical owner for the deep-dive.

One ask: can we move the technical deep-dive to Thu Aug 14, 11:00–11:45 PT instead of Aug 13? Our SRE lead is only available then. The exec slot on Aug 12 at 10:30am works for our VP of Engineering.

Also: please add a short pre-read (2 slides) focused on latency distribution and expected token cost delta for the dedicated nodes — that helps our FinOps lead evaluate the uplift.

Carlos Mendez
Sr. Engineering Manager — Platform
Atlas Health
c.mendez@atlashealth.com
Attachment: capacity-estimate.csv (csv)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emma Sanders <emma.sanders@atlashealth.com>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2025-08-06T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning & exec demo request

Thanks Carlos — Aug 12 at 10:30am PT is confirmed for the exec demo; technical deep-dive moved to Thu Aug 14, 11:00–11:45 PT. Calendar invites sent.

I’ll own the 24-month pricing options and will share two bullets in advance: standard discount ladder vs. committed-capacity pricing. Expect a short pricing note by EOD Aug 7.

Pre-reads: Evelyn will upload a 2-slide latency/token-cost summary and the MAP into the HubSpot deal. We’ll also send a DocuSign link for a short amendment draft after the kickoff if the team wants to fast-track terms.

Action items (owners):
- Evelyn: upload pre-read + MAP (by Aug 8)
- Carlos: confirm SRE attendance + capacity numbers (by Aug 10)
- Rishi: pricing options + amendment draft (by Aug 7)

Looking forward — see you on Aug 12.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Attachment: pre-read-deck.pdf (pdf)
